messages:
hannah-ops: Heads-up: scheduling a low-traffic maintenance to run staggered warm reboots + kernel micro-update on a small cohort in eu-west2 and us-west2. Window: 2025-09-02 01:00-03:00 UTC. Cohorts: 3 nodes every 20m. Pre-seed KV 30m ahead.
liam-sre: +1. Plan: 5m network canary -> drain -> reboot -> 10m post-check. Abort if packet loss >0.4% or p95 > baseline*1.25.
violet-runtime: Runtime ops: enable prefix-cache priming 25m prior, lower max_batch_size to 18 for the window, and set routing-policy to prefer warm fallback pools. I'll flip flags at 00:30.
sam-support: I'll draft status and targeted customer notifications. Post at 00:20? Any dedicated impacts?
hannah-ops: No dedicated pool down. Affected pools: shared-eu-west2, shared-us-west2. No pinned tenants on the impacted blades. Post at 00:20 is good.
liam-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# canary
kubectl cordon node-canary
kubectl drain node-canary --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
sleep 300
curl -fsS http://internal-probe/health || rollback
```
violet-runtime: Cost estimate: expected token backfill ~0.45% for the 2h window due to cold prefixes. Tagging billing-team; if >0.9% we abort.
ops-bot: calendar event created: quietwindow-warmreboots (2025-09-02T01:00Z-2025-09-02T03:00Z). Reference: #INC000807654. Pager rotations preserved.
liam-sre: I'll post canary telemetry (packet loss, tail p95, queue depth) at 01:05 and call go/no-go.
hannah-ops: Final checklist: pre-seed 00:30, runtime flags 00:30, post status update 00:20, canary 01:00. Thanks team :thumbsup:
